items.title: Frank Foster and Bill Hughes interviewed by Monk Rowe and Michael Woods, Schenectady, New York, March 28, 1995
items.q: I think Johnny Griffin still lives over there.

ctx.x: So wonderful that a lot of people were persuaded to move there.
That right. Ben Webster, Don Byas, Coleman Hawkins. Now some have come back, you know Slide Hampton lived over there for years. I think Johnny Griffin still lives over there.
